entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I assist you today?
I can certainly help with that. To pull up your account, could I get your full name and order number?
Sarah Miller. Order number is VF98765.
Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the ProFit Jersey. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the item?
I see. And is it a technical fault with the jersey, or a preference on the fit?
It's just too tight. Your sizing chart must be off.

I'm sorry to hear it didn't fit as expected. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. I see it was delivered nine days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can process this for you right now. Were you hoping for a refund, or would you like to exchange it for a larger size?
A refund. I don't want to risk another exchange if the sizing is a guessing game.

I understand completely. I have just initiated the return process for a full refund. You should receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just package the jersey and send it back to us, and we'll process your refund once it arrives. Can I help with anything else?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Sarah. Have a great day.
